description: Hierarchical model shape cases (PX-018-G01, §8, §26). Each case is a sparse cache of [index, tree_depth, descendant_count] rows (null = absent; a negative number or a string is malformed) checked against item_count and max_model_tree_depth. expected is null when the cache is accepted, else the first violation's conformance code and index. The Rust store (model_tree_test), the Swift replica (ModelTreeStoreTests) and the Python reference in protocol/tests/test_model_tree_shape_cases.py must all agree row for row.
